title: Seede bu safara bi
intro: Nit ku xóot, ku bëggoon xam dëgg gi mujj, dafa dugg ci tukkib gis-gis ngëm. Seen gëm-gëm gu dëggu moo leen yóbbe ñu bañ seeni sàrt yuñ tëral, ñu jànkoonte ak jafe-jafe yu metti yuy natt fi ngëm yam. Jaar-jaaru ruuh bii dafay firndeel ni Yàlla moo ko aar ak tegtal.
clues: Sama Boroom daf ma barkeel ci titre bu amul fenn, muy màndargaal limu nu jàpp bu xóot te amul fenn.
Bi may ndaw, maa ngi nekkoon ci biir nit ñu daan sukku ci kanam nataal yuñ defar, waaye sama xol yàggoon na lool ci Benn Yàlla bu Dëgg bi.
Ma xool mbindéef yi ci asamaan si, jant bi, weer wi ak biddiiw yi, di xalaat seen fenk ak seen wàcci, gis ni mënu ñu nekk sama Boroom.
Ngir xeex polytheism bi tasaaroo, ma jàkkarloo ak yàlla yu baaxul yi, bàyyi benn bu gëna mag bu amul benn sikk, muy tuumalkat bu noppi.
Lima bañoon jaamu yàlla yi moo jur ñu yar ma bu baax, ndax dañu ma jàpp ni dañu ma sànni ci safara bu tàng.
Waaye, ci ndigalu sama Boroom, xal yu tàng yi soppiku nekk lu sedd ak kaaraange, muccal sama dundu.
arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire." (37:97)
